answer: Yes, the shop accepts customers bringing their own coffee beans, though there is a charge for doing so. A barista in the shop can confirm the exact charge and details.

The shop is normally open 9 am to 5 pm. Hours may differ when a private event is being held, so please reconfirm with a barista in the shop. If you'd like to hold your own private event at the shop, visit in person to arrange it with a barista.
Yes, the shop is available for delivery through Grab Food and Foodpanda -- check either app to place a delivery order.
